question: Retrieve distinct case references, case numbers, investigation numbers, and clone information where a single clone simultaneously exhibits all three of the following genetic alterations: (1) a loss on chromosome 13 between positions 48,303,751 and 48,481,890, (2) a loss on chromosome 17 between positions 7,668,421 and 7,687,490, and (3) a gain on chromosome 11 between positions 108,223,067 and 108,369,102. For each matching clone, display the chromosomal details for each of these three regions (including chromosome number represented by ChrOrd, start position, and end position) and the corresponding karyotype short description from the KaryClone table. Use the CytoConverted and KaryClone.
sql:
WITH loss13 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start < 48481890 AND `End` > 48303751
),
loss17 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start < 7687490 AND `End` > 7668421
),
gain11 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' AND Start < 108369102 AND `End` > 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l13.RefNo, l13.CaseNo, l13.InvNo, l13.Clone
  FROM loss13 l13
  INNER JOIN loss17 l17 ON l13.RefNo = l17.RefNo AND l13.CaseNo = l17.CaseNo AND l13.InvNo = l17.InvNo AND l13.Clone = l17.Clone
  INNER JOIN gain11 g11 ON l13.RefNo = g11.RefNo AND l13.CaseNo = g11.CaseNo AND l13.InvNo = g11.InvNo AND l13.Clone = g11.Clone
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  mc.RefNo,
  mc.CaseNo,
  mc.InvNo,
  mc.Clone,
  kc.CloneShort AS KaryClone_Short,
  l13.ChrOrd AS Chr13_Ord,
  l13.Start AS Chr13_Start,
  l13.`End` AS Chr13_End,
  l17.ChrOrd AS Chr17_Ord,
  l17.Start AS Chr17_Start,
  l17.`End` AS Chr17_End,
  g11.ChrOrd AS Chr11_Ord,
  g11.Start AS Chr11_Start,
  g11.`End` AS Chr11_End
FROM matching_clones mc
INNER JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc 
  ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo
LEFT JOIN loss13 l13 ON mc.RefNo = l13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = l13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = l13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = l13.Clone AND l13.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN loss17 l17 ON mc.RefNo = l17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = l17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = l17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = l17.Clone AND l17.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN gain11 g11 ON mc.RefNo = g11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = g11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = g11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = g11.Clone AND g11.rn = 1
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone
